text:
Posting the conclusion for future reference:
It was no problem to get the MoT ID on a B2 with 5 month validity left. I went in Ramat Gan, was able to walk in without appointment after explaining what I need, and got issued the id number with no further questions about what visa I have. Just needed to show my passport and visa stickers. Filled out the health questionnaire and did the photo and eye check, and got a text confirming I can now schedule the theory exam, which seems also the point at which you would be able to convert your license… If I manage to snag an appointment 🤞
Thanks again for your help!
